title: greet
body:
Expected result: Correct password par article delete ho jana chahiye. Wrong password par error aayega aur article safe rahega.
Step 6 — Edit Function Test
Kisi doosre test article par Edit click karein, title ya text change karein, password enter karke Save Changes press karein.
Note: Har Edit aur Delete ke liye password dobara dena hoga. Browser ka password-save popup aaye to Never select kar sakte hain.
Ab pehle Delete test karein aur bata dein:
- Deleted successfully
- Error aa raha hai — screenshot bhej dein.HI
